title: Auth0 or Firebase Authentication: Adding Sign-In to Your App
excerpt: Auth0, now part of Okta, is a highly customisable identity platform; Firebase Authentication, from Google, offers fast, ready-made sign-in for web and mobile apps. Complexity and scale decide between them.
verdict: Auth0 is the stronger choice for businesses that need complex, customised authentication flows and enterprise identity features. Firebase Authentication is faster and cheaper for simple web and mobile apps that need sign-in working quickly.

spec1.label: Flexibility and custom flows
spec1.device1Value: Very flexible for complex enterprise scenarios
spec1.device2Value: Simpler and faster, but less flexible for complex cases

spec2.label: Integrating into a simple mobile app
spec2.device1Value: Good, though a little more involved
